SELECT COUNT(*) / 12 || CASE WHEN COUNT(*) % 12 = 0 THEN '' ELSE ' ' || (COUNT(*) % 12) / CASE WHEN COUNT(*) % 12 IN (2, 10) THEN 2 WHEN COUNT(*) % 12 IN (3, 9) THEN 3 WHEN COUNT(*) % 12 IN (4, 8) THEN 4 WHEN COUNT(*) % 12 = 6 THEN 6 ELSE 1 END || '/' || 12 / CASE WHEN COUNT(*) % 12 IN (2, 10) THEN 2 WHEN COUNT(*) % 12 IN (3, 9) THEN 3 WHEN COUNT(*) % 12 IN (4, 8) THEN 4 WHEN COUNT(*) % 12 = 6 THEN 6 ELSE 1 END END AS "average_schools_per_month" FROM "schools" WHERE county = 'San Diego' AND opendate >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND opendate < DATE '1981-01-01' AND doctype IN ('Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District') AND school IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".county, "s".district, "s".city, "f"."Enrollment (K-12)", "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)", "f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", "a".numtsttakr, "a".avgscrread, "a".avgscrmath, "a".avgscrwrite, "a".numge1500 FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "a" ON "a".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".cdscode = '01612590137943' LIMIT 501

SELECT "q".school AS "School name", ROUND("q".rate, 4) AS "Free meal rate", CASE WHEN "q".charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN "q".charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Charter school", "q".gsserved AS "Grades served", CASE WHEN "sat".avgscrread IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrmath IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrwrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS "SAT performance level" FROM (SELECT "s".cdscode, "s".school, "s".charter, "s".gsserved, "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 0) AS "rate", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 0) DESC) AS "rate_rank" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".county = 'Alameda' AND ("s".gsserved = '12' OR "s".gsserved LIKE '%-12') AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0 AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL) AS "q" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "q".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "q".rate_rank = 1 ORDER BY "q".school ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school AS "name", "s".phone, "s".website, "sat".avgscrread AS "average SAT reading score", "sat".avgscrmath AS "average SAT math score", "sat".avgscrwrite AS "average SAT writing score", ("s".charter = 1) AS "charter school", "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "K-12 enrollment", ROUND(("f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"::NUMERIC * 100), 2) AS "percentage eligible for free or reduced price meals", (SELECT MAX("a".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "a" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "active_school" ON "active_school".cdscode = "a".cds WHERE "active_school".statustype = 'Active' AND "a".rtype = 'S' AND "a".numtsttakr >= 10) AS "highest average SAT math score", (SELECT MAX("a".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "a" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "active_school" ON "active_school".cdscode = "a".cds WHERE "active_school".statustype = 'Active' AND "a".rtype = 'S' AND "a".numtsttakr >= 10) - "sat".avgscrmath AS "difference from highest average SAT math score" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' WHERE "s".cdscode = '07618040113118' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".county, "c".school_count, COALESCE("top_schools".school, 'None') AS "school_name" FROM (SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS "school_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "count_rank" FROM "schools" WHERE virtual = 'F' GROUP BY county) AS "c" LEFT JOIN (SELECT county, school, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY avgscrread DESC) AS "reading_rank" FROM (SELECT "s".county, "s".school, MAX("sat".avgscrread) AS "avgscrread" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".virtual = 'F' AND "sat".avgscrread IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "s".cdscode, "s".county, "s".school) AS "school_scores") AS "top_schools" ON "c".county = "top_schools".county AND "top_schools".reading_rank = 1 WHERE "c".count_rank <= 5 ORDER BY "c".school_count DESC, "c".county ASC, school_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("u".reputation) AS "combined_reputation" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE score = 10 AND tags LIKE '%<r>%') AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id LIMIT 501

AND "ph2".comment IS NOT NULL AND "ph2".comment <> '' GROUP BY "ph2".userid, COALESCE("u2".displayname, "ph2".userdisplayname)) AS "s") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') - MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "sme_minus_lam", ROUND((MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') - MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "lam_minus_kam", ROUND((MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') - MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "kam_minus_sme" FROM (SELECT segment, total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total ASC, customerid ASC) AS "rank_in_segment" FROM (SELECT "c".segment, "c".customerid, SUM("y".consumption::NUMERIC) AS "total" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' GROUP BY "c".segment, "c".customerid) AS "totals") AS "ranked" WHERE rank_in_segment = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT segment, ROUND(increase_percentage, 2) AS "increase_percentage" FROM (SELECT segment, increase_percentage, MAX(increase_percentage) OVER () AS "highest", MIN(increase_percentage) OVER () AS "lowest" FROM (SELECT "c".segment, 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' THEN "y".consumption::NUMERIC ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301' THEN "y".consumption::NUMERIC ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301' THEN "y".consumption::NUMERIC ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201401' GROUP BY "c".segment) AS "changes" WHERE increase_percentage IS NOT NULL) AS "extremes" WHERE increase_percentage = highest OR increase_percentage = lowest ORDER BY increase_percentage DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(("a".overall_rating - "p".overall_rating) * 100.0 / NULLIF("p".overall_rating, 0), 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM (SELECT "pa".overall_rating FROM "player" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "pl".player_api_id WHERE "pl".player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' ORDER BY "pa".date DESC NULLS LAST, "pa".id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "a" CROSS JOIN (SELECT "pa".overall_rating FROM "player" AS "pl" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "pl".player_api_id WHERE "pl".player_name = 'Paulin Puel' ORDER BY "pa".date DESC NULLS LAST, "pa".id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "p" LIMIT 501

SELECT "pa".date FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "pa".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name = 'Kevin Constant' AND "pa".crossing IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "pa".crossing DESC, "pa".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "pa".player_api_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id AND "pa".overall_rating > 70 WHERE "p".height < 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height), 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT home_player_3 FROM "match") AS "m" ON "m".home_player_3 = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height > 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_high) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT "p".player_api_id, BOOL_OR("pa".defensive_work_rate = 'high') AS "has_high" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".birthday >= '1991-01-01' AND "pa".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') GROUP BY "p".player_api_id) AS "rated_players" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("mc".matches_played, 0)), 2) AS "average_matches" FROM (SELECT player_api_id FROM (SELECT player_api_id, overall_rating, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "player_attributes" WHERE date < '2011-01-01') AS "ratings" WHERE rn = 1 AND overall_rating > 80) AS "shortlisted" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "p".player_api_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".id) AS "matches_played" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "m".season = '2010/2011' GROUP BY "p".player_api_id) AS "mc" ON "mc".player_api_id = "shortlisted".player_api_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, defensive_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS "current_rating" ON "current_rating".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "current_rating".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'high') LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_short_name, COUNT(*) AS "club_count", ROUND(AVG("a".chancecreationpassing), 1) AS "average_chance_creation_passing_risk" FROM "team" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id FROM "team_attributes" WHERE chancecreationpassingclass = 'Risky') AS "risky" ON "risky".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (team_api_id) team_api_id, chancecreationpassing FROM "team_attributes" WHERE date < '2014-09-20' ORDER BY team_api_id ASC, date DESC, id DESC) AS "a" ON "a".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id GROUP BY "t".team_short_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY average_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC NULLS LAST, "t".team_short_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height), 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, defensive_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" WHERE defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC, id DESC) AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".birthday >= '1990-01-01' AND "p".birthday < '1996-01-01' AND "a".defensive_work_rate = 'medium' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".weight), 1) AS "average_weight" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id FROM "player_attributes" WHERE preferred_foot = 'left') AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".player_name, COUNT("m".id) AS "matches_played" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".season = '2015/2016' AND "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "p".player_name LIKE 'Adam%' AND "p".weight > 170 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".player_name LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "ta".buildupplaydribblingclass FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "ta".team_api_id INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".home_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id OR "m".away_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id INNER JOIN "country" AS "c" ON "c".id = "m".country_id WHERE "t".team_short_name = 'POR' AND "c".name = 'England' AND "ta".date >= '2015-09-10' AND "ta".date < '2015-09-11' LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_long_name AS "club_name", "t".team_short_name AS "short_name", COUNT(*) AS "home_wins" FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "m".home_team_api_id WHERE "m".home_team_goal - "m".away_team_goal >= 3 AND (SELECT "ta".buildupplayspeedclass FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta" WHERE "ta".team_api_id = "m".home_team_api_id AND "ta".date <= "m".date ORDER BY "ta".date DESC, "ta".id DESC LIMIT 1) = 'Fast' GROUP BY "t".id, "t".team_long_name, "t".team_short_name ORDER BY home_wins DESC, "t".team_long_name ASC, "t".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "qualifying_players" FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "country" AS "c" ON "c".id = "m".country_id INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "p".weight >= 210 GROUP BY "c".id, "c".name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) = (SELECT MAX(country_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p2".player_api_id) AS "country_count" FROM "match" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p2" ON "p2".player_api_id IN ("m2".home_player_1, "m2".home_player_2, "m2".home_player_3, "m2".home_player_4, "m2".home_player_5, "m2".home_player_6, "m2".home_player_7, "m2".home_player_8, "m2".home_player_9, "m2".home_player_10, "m2".home_player_11, "m2".away_player_1, "m2".away_player_2, "m2".away_player_3, "m2".away_player_4, "m2".away_player_5, "m2".away_player_6, "m2".away_player_7, "m2".away_player_8, "m2".away_player_9, "m2".away_player_10, "m2".away_player_11) WHERE "p2".weight >= 210 GROUP BY "m2".country_id) AS "counts") ORDER BY "c".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "appearances".season, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "player_count", ROUND(AVG("p".height::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "m".season, "p".player_api_id FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "country" AS "c" ON "c".id = "m".country_id INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "c".name = 'Italy' AND "m".season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')) AS "appearances" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "appearances".player_api_id GROUP BY "appearances".season ORDER BY "appearances".season ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "player_count" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, volleys FROM "player_attributes" ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height > 180 AND "a".volleys > 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("t".total_goals, 0)), 2) AS "average_total_home_goals" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT home_player_3, SUM(home_team_goal) AS "total_goals" FROM "match" GROUP BY home_player_3) AS "t" ON "t".home_player_3 = "p".player_api_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name FROM "country" AS "c" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".country_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "p".weight <= 160 GROUP BY "c".id, "c".name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) = (SELECT MIN("country_count".player_count) FROM (SELECT "c2".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "p2".player_api_id) AS "player_count" FROM "country" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m2" ON "m2".country_id = "c2".id LEFT JOIN "player" AS "p2" ON "p2".weight <= 160 AND "p2".player_api_id IN ("m2".home_player_1, "m2".home_player_2, "m2".home_player_3, "m2".home_player_4, "m2".home_player_5, "m2".home_player_6, "m2".home_player_7, "m2".home_player_8, "m2".home_player_9, "m2".home_player_10, "m2".home_player_11, "m2".away_player_1, "m2".away_player_2, "m2".away_player_3, "m2".away_player_4, "m2".away_player_5, "m2".away_player_6, "m2".away_player_7, "m2".away_player_8, "m2".away_player_9, "m2".away_player_10, "m2".away_player_11) GROUP BY "c2".id) AS "country_count") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "player_count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("pa".player_api_id) "pa".player_api_id, "pa".preferred_foot, "pa".attacking_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "pa".player_api_id WHERE "pa".date < '2015-01-02' ORDER BY "pa".player_api_id ASC, "pa".date DESC, "pa".id DESC) AS "latest" WHERE "latest".preferred_foot = 'left' AND "latest".attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "current_attributes".attacking_work_rate = 'low') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS "current_attributes" WHERE "current_attributes".preferred_foot = 'left' AND "current_attributes".attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".player_name, COUNT("m".id) AS "matches_played" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".season = '2015/2016' AND "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "p".player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND "p".birthday >= '1991-01-01' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".player_name ORDER BY "p".player_name ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS "player_count" FROM "player_attributes" WHERE jumping >= 80 AND date >= '2007-02-22' AND date < '2007-08-31' LIMIT 501

SELECT "ta".buildupplayspeedclass FROM "team" AS "t" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "t".team_api_id = "m".home_team_api_id OR "t".team_api_id = "m".away_team_api_id INNER JOIN "team_attributes" AS "ta" ON "ta".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id AND "ta".date <= "m".date WHERE "t".team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge' AND "m".season = '2012/2013' ORDER BY "m".date DESC, "ta".date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN "p".player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN "a".overall_rating END) / NULLIF(AVG(CASE WHEN "a".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') THEN "a".overall_rating END), 0) - 1), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, overall_rating, defensive_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" WHERE date < '2013-07-13' ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC, id DESC) AS "a" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "a".player_api_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".account_id, (SELECT MAX(a11) - MIN(a11) FROM "district") AS "salary_difference" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "r" ON "r".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "r".a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM "district") AND "c".birth_date = (SELECT MIN("c2".birth_date) FROM "client" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "district" AS "r2" ON "r2".district_id = "c2".district_id WHERE "c2".gender = 'F' AND "r2".a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM "district")) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".a2 AS "district" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "p".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date = DATE '1976-01-29' AND "p".type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".gender = 'M') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "male_percentage" FROM "client" AS "c" WHERE "c".district_id = (SELECT "d".district_id FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = 'south Bohemia' ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT ("end_balance".balance - "start_balance".balance)::NUMERIC * 100 / NULLIF("start_balance".balance, 0) AS "percentage_increase" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "start_balance" ON "start_balance".account_id = "l".account_id AND "start_balance".date = DATE '1993-03-22' INNER JOIN "trans" AS "end_balance" ON "end_balance".account_id = "l".account_id AND "end_balance".date = DATE '1998-12-27' WHERE "l".date = DATE '1993-07-05' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".frequency FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '2001-01-01' AND "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".a2 AS "district", ROUND((("d".a13::NUMERIC - "d".a12::NUMERIC) / NULLIF("d".a12::NUMERIC, 0)) * 100, 2) AS "unemployment_rate_percentage_change" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "l".status = 'D' AND "d".a12 IS NOT NULL AND "d".a13 IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "d".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "dist" ON "dist".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".type <> 'OWNER' AND "dist".a11 > 8000 AND "dist".a11 <= 9000 GROUP BY "d".type LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN "l".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01' THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01' THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "percentage_growth" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "l".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id AND "c".gender = 'M' WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".frequency, "o".k_symbol FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".account_id = 3 GROUP BY "a".frequency, "o".k_symbol HAVING SUM("o".amount) = 3539 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "a".date >= (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) FROM "account") AND "a".date < (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) + INTERVAL '1 month' FROM "account") GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a4 HAVING "d".a4::BIGINT = (SELECT MAX("d2".a4::BIGINT) FROM "district" AS "d2" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".district_id = "d2".district_id WHERE "a2".date >= (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) FROM "account") AND "a2".date < (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) + INTERVAL '1 month' FROM "account")) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM("t".k_symbol) = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id), 0)) AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM (SELECT district_id, a2 FROM "district" ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST, district_id ASC LIMIT 5) AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id), 0) DESC NULLS LAST, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_approved_amount" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date + "l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month' > DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY "d".a3 HAVING SUM("l".amount) = (SELECT MAX(region_total) FROM (SELECT SUM("l2".amount) AS "region_total" FROM "loan" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".account_id = "l2".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "a2".district_id WHERE "l2".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l2".date + "l2".duration * INTERVAL '1 month' > DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY "d2".a3) AS "totals") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary", COUNT(*) AS "district_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') AS "eligible" ON "eligible".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN "disp" AS "account_disp" ON "account_disp".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id LEFT JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "account_disp".disp_id GROUP BY "c".district_id, "owner_disp".account_id HAVING COUNT("ca".card_id) = 0) AS "eligible" ON "eligible".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "a".account_id, COUNT("l".loan_id) AS "loan_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id) AS "account_loans" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO' AND NULLIF(TRIM("t".k_symbol), '') IS NOT NULL) AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') AS "cohort" ON "cohort".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".amount > 4000 AND "t".type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id AS "account_number", "a".date AS "account_opening_date", "l".total_borrowed, COALESCE("t".counterparties, 0) AS "outside_bank_counterparties", "home".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "home".a4::BIGINT AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "home".a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST) AS "population_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS "counterparties" FROM "trans" WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND bank IS NOT NULL AND bank <> '' GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' ORDER BY "home".a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".gender, "s".district_count, "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4 AS "inhabitants", "s".average_salary, "s".average_urban_ratio FROM (SELECT "q".gender, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", MAX("q".inhabitants) AS "max_inhabitants", ROUND(AVG("q".salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND(AVG("q".urban_ratio)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_urban_ratio" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "di".district_id, "di".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "di".a11 AS "salary", "di".a10 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "card_disp" ON "card_disp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "card_disp".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "di" ON "di".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND "di".a4::BIGINT > 100000) AS "q" GROUP BY "q".gender) AS "s" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "di".district_id, "di".a2, "di".a4 FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "card_disp" ON "card_disp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "card_disp".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "di" ON "di".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND "di".a4::BIGINT > 100000) AS "d" ON "d".gender = "s".gender AND "d".a4::BIGINT = "s".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE WHEN "s".gender = 'F' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".bank AS "recipient_bank_code", "t".account AS "recipient_counter_account", COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "p".account_id FROM "disp" AS "p" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "p".disp_id WHERE "p".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'gold') AS "gold_accounts" ON "gold_accounts".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "d".a4::BIGINT >= 250000 AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".bank <> '' AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY SUM("t".amount) DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND NULLIF(TRIM("t".k_symbol), '') IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "x".region, ROUND(AVG("x".salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG("x".unemployment)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_district_unemployment_rate", MAX(CASE WHEN "x".rn = 1 THEN "x".district_name END) AS "most_populous_district" FROM (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a12 AS "unemployment", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST, "d".a2 ASC) AS "rn" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "p".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "p".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "p".type = 'OWNER') AS "eligible" ON "eligible".district_id = "d".district_id) AS "x" GROUP BY "x".region ORDER BY "x".region ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".a2 AS "district_name", "t".a15 AS "crimes_1996", ROUND((SELECT AVG("s".a15) FROM (SELECT "d".a15 FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, TRANSLATE(LOWER("d".a2), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 3) AS "s"), 2) AS "three_district_average", ROUND((SELECT AVG("d".a15) FROM "district" AS "d"), 2) AS "overall_average", ROUND((SELECT AVG("s".a15) FROM (SELECT "d".a15 FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, TRANSLATE(LOWER("d".a2), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 3) AS "s") - (SELECT AVG("d".a15) FROM "district" AS "d"), 2) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT "d".a2, "d".a4, "d".a15 FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, TRANSLATE(LOWER("d".a2), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 3) AS "t" ORDER BY CAST("t".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, TRANSLATE(LOWER("t".a2), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC, "t".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT card_type, district, inhabitants FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".type AS "card_type", "d".a2 AS "district", CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) AS "inhabitants", DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "c".type ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) ASC) AS "population_rank" FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".disp_id = "c".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "p".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id WHERE "c".type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior') AND "d".a4 IS NOT NULL) AS "ranked" WHERE population_rank = 1 ORDER BY card_type ASC, district ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".district_name, "s".accounts_opened, ROUND("s".district_average, 2) AS "average_end_of_1996_balance", ROUND(SUM("s".balance_sum) OVER () / NULLIF(SUM("s".balance_count) OVER (), 0), 2) AS "region_wide_average_end_of_1996_balance", FIRST_VALUE("s".district_name) OVER (ORDER BY "s".district_average DESC NULLS LAST, "s".district_name ASC) AS "district_with_highest_average" FROM (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", AVG("t".balance) AS "district_average", SUM("t".balance) AS "balance_sum", COUNT("t".balance) AS "balance_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (account_id) account_id, balance FROM "trans" WHERE date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY account_id ASC, date DESC, trans_id DESC) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "d".a3 = (SELECT "d2".a3 FROM "district" AS "d2" WHERE "d2".a2 = 'Litomerice') GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2) AS "s" ORDER BY "s".district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", (SELECT ROUND(AVG("d2".a11::NUMERIC), 2) FROM "district" AS "d2" WHERE "d2".district_id IN (SELECT "a2".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".account_id = "l2".account_id WHERE "l2".duration = 24 AND "a2".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l2".amount DESC, "l2".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10)) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".district_id IN (SELECT "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST, "d".district_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn", ROUND(SUM("t".amount)::NUMERIC / "d".a4::BIGINT, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("t".amount)::NUMERIC / "d".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "withdrawal_rank", ROUND((SELECT COALESCE(SUM("o".amount::NUMERIC), 0) FROM "order" AS "o" INNER JOIN "account" AS "ao" ON "ao".account_id = "o".account_id WHERE "ao".district_id = "d".district_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "account" AS "aa" WHERE "aa".district_id = "d".district_id), 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4 ORDER BY withdrawal_rank ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "account_opened", "a".frequency, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "d".district_id = "c".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "is_home_district", "d".a11 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("t".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("t".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("t".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("t".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "r".client_count AS "region_client_count", "r".most_populous_district, "r".inhabitants AS "most_populous_district_inhabitants", "d".population_rank AS "account_district_population_rank" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "di".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT district_id, a2, a3, a11, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST) AS "population_rank" FROM "district") AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "x".a3, "x".a2 AS "most_populous_district", "x".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "client" AS "rc" INNER JOIN "district" AS "rd" ON "rd".district_id = "rc".district_id WHERE "rd".a3 = "x".a3) AS "client_count", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "x".a3 ORDER BY "x".a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST, "x".district_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "district" AS "x") AS "r" ON "r".a3 = "d".a3 AND "r".rn = 1 WHERE "c".client_id = 3541 ORDER BY COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT year AS "account_opening_year", SUM(account_count) AS "number_of_accounts", SUM(amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG(amount_lent / account_count), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY') AS "year", "a".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count", SUM(COALESCE("l".amount_lent, 0)) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "amount_lent" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY'), "a".district_id) AS "district_year" GROUP BY year ORDER BY year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "l".amount AS "approved_amount", "l".date AS "approval_date", (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t".date <= "l".date ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "account_balance" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT "c".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) AS "age_at_card_issue", COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("l".total_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'Non-borrower' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' ELSE 'Mature borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "c".gender ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) DESC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "di".client_id LEFT JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", SUM(amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "di".account_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01' ORDER BY "c".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date < DATE '1998-10-15' AND ("t".k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM("t".k_symbol) = '') WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank AS "bank_code", "t".account AS "account_number", COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".amount = 98832 AND "l".date = DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id IN (SELECT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" WHERE "d".client_id = 2823) AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

SELECT "f".client_id, "f".amount AS "loan_amount", "f".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND("f".payments::NUMERIC * "f".duration, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND("f".payments::NUMERIC * "f".duration - "f".amount, 2) AS "interest_paid", "f".status AS "loan_status", "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", ROUND(COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "f".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0) > "f".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "r".loan_count AS "loans_in_region", "s".average_salary AS "region_average_salary", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "f".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".duration, "l".payments, "l".status, "c".client_id, "c".birth_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC) AS "amount_rank" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "l".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F') AS "f" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "f".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "f".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "d2".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".account_id = "l2".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "a2".district_id GROUP BY "d2".a3) AS "r" ON "r".region = "d".a3 INNER JOIN (SELECT a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG(a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" GROUP BY a3) AS "s" ON "s".region = "d".a3 WHERE "f".amount_rank <= 3 ORDER BY "f".amount DESC, "f".loan_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(DISTINCT "d".district_id) AS "district_count", SUM("d".a4::BIGINT) AS "population", SUM("q".account_count) AS "account_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".duration > 24 GROUP BY "a".district_id) AS "q" ON "q".district_id = "d".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3 ORDER BY population DESC, "d".a3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("q".account_count), 0) AS "total_monthly_statement_accounts", COUNT(*) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("q".salary), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a11 AS "salary", COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) >= 100000 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a11) AS "q" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("t".total_received, 0) AS "total_received", COALESCE("t".total_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_withdrawn", COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", COALESCE("t".counterparty_count, 0) AS "external_counterparties", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("t".counterparty_count, 0) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "di".account_id FROM "disp" AS "di" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "di".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold') AS "g" ON "g".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_received", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT (bank, account)) FILTER (WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND bank IS NOT NULL AND account IS NOT NULL) AS "counterparty_count" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id ORDER BY rank ASC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "c".gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "c".birth_date)) AS "owner_age", COALESCE("cd".card_count, 0) AS "card_count", COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", CASE WHEN COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan' WHEN "l".has_default THEN 'defaulted' WHEN "l".has_repaying THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END AS "loan_standing", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("t".money_in, 0) AS "money_in", COALESCE("t".money_out, 0) AS "money_out", COALESCE("t".peak_balance, 0) AS "peak_balance", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("t".peak_balance, 0) DESC) AS "balance_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "dp".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "card_count" FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "dp".disp_id WHERE "ca".issued < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY "dp".account_id) AS "cd" ON "cd".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", BOOL_OR(status = 'B') AS "has_default", BOOL_OR(status IN ('C', 'D')) AS "has_repaying" FROM "loan" WHERE date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_in", SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_out", MAX(balance) AS "peak_balance" FROM "trans" WHERE date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Tabor' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY balance_rank ASC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "o".client_id) AS "client_count", COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL) AS "external_account_count", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount), 0) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "dp".client_id, "dp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "dp".disp_id WHERE "dp".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'classic') AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "o".account_id AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" ON "disp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "disp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01') AS "matched_districts" ON "matched_districts".district_id = "d".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary_czk" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "client" WHERE gender = 'F' AND birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("x".a11), 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a11 FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "l".amount < 100000 AND "l".status = 'C') AS "x" LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END AS "cohort", ROUND(AVG("d".a11)) AS "average_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "p".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' OR "c".birth_date < DATE '1920-01-01' GROUP BY CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END ORDER BY CASE WHEN CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END = 'young' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, MAX("ds".points) AS "highest_recorded_driver_standings_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid AND "res".position = 1 LEFT JOIN "driverstandings" AS "ds" ON "ds".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".driverid = (SELECT "r".driverid FROM "results" AS "r" WHERE "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "r".driverid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "r".driverid ASC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(("last_finisher".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds)::NUMERIC * 100 / "last_finisher".milliseconds, 2) AS "percentage" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 INNER JOIN "results" AS "last_finisher" ON "last_finisher".raceid = "r".raceid AND "last_finisher".laps = "winner".laps AND "last_finisher".position = (SELECT MAX("res".position) FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".laps = "winner".laps AND "res".position IS NOT NULL) WHERE "r".year = 1988 AND "r".name = 'Australian Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "e".laps = "w".laps) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "e" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "e".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "e".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "w" ON "w".raceid = "e".raceid AND "w".position = 1 WHERE "d".nationality = 'Japanese' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, ROUND(AVG("res".milliseconds::NUMERIC) / 1000, 2) AS "mean_winner_elapsed_seconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year < 1975 AND "res".position = 1 AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND "res".laps > 50) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "c".name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND "r".year = 2008 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' ORDER BY "q".q3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("race_stops".stop_count), 2) AS "average_pit_stops_per_race" FROM (SELECT "r".raceid, COUNT("p".stop) AS "stop_count" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "races" AS "old_race" WHERE "old_race".year = 2000 AND "old_race".name = "r".name) GROUP BY "r".raceid) AS "race_stops" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 <> '' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MAX("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q1 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND (split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q_other".driverid) AS "drivers_outqualified" FROM "qualifying" AS "q_lucas" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q_lucas".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q_lucas".raceid INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q_other" ON "q_other".raceid = "q_lucas".raceid AND "q_other".position > "q_lucas".position WHERE "d".forename = 'Lucas' AND "d".surname = 'di Grassi' AND "r".year = 2010 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 <> '' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q2 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(*) AS "runner_up_count" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "res".position = 2 GROUP BY "d".forename HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY runner_up_count DESC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q2), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q3), '') IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT "q2".q2 FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' ORDER BY (split_part("q2".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT forename FROM "drivers" GROUP BY forename HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS "shared" ON "shared".forename = "d".forename WHERE ("d".code IS NULL OR "d".code = '') AND CASE WHEN "q".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-5][0-9]([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC > 120 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "l".raceid IS NOT NULL THEN "r".points ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "total_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT raceid, driverid FROM "laptimes") AS "l" ON "l".driverid = "r".driverid AND "l".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".driverref LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name", "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year", "q".q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'British' AND "d2".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ranked_laps".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM (SELECT "l".driverid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".raceid ORDER BY MIN("l".milliseconds) ASC) AS "lap_rank" FROM "laptimes" AS "l" WHERE "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "l".raceid, "l".driverid) AS "ranked_laps" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ranked_laps".driverid WHERE "ranked_laps".lap_rank = 2 AND "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "ranked".name, "ranked".career_points, "ranked".url FROM (SELECT "totals".name, "totals".career_points, "totals".url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "totals".career_points DESC) AS "constructor_rank" FROM (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("final_standings".points), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "cs".points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year ORDER BY "r".round DESC, "r".date DESC, "r".raceid DESC) AS "season_order" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid) AS "final_standings" ON "final_standings".constructorid = "c".constructorid AND "final_standings".season_order = 1 WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url) AS "totals") AS "ranked" WHERE "ranked".constructor_rank <= 3 ORDER BY "ranked".constructor_rank ASC, "ranked".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename ORDER BY CASE "d".forename WHEN 'Peter' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT "r".constructorid) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".constructorid = "c".constructorid AND "r".rank = 1 GROUP BY "c".nationality ORDER BY "c".nationality ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, COUNT("p".stop) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) AS "eligible" ON "eligible".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "number_of_drivers" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "r".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND CASE WHEN "q".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC > 120 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "p2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < DATE '2016-10-01') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name", "d".nationality, "first_win".name AS "race_name", "first_win".date AS "race_date", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "results" AS "career_results" INNER JOIN "races" AS "career_races" ON "career_races".raceid = "career_results".raceid WHERE "career_results".driverid = "d".driverid AND "career_races".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 AND "career_results".grid > 0) AS "races_started" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winning_result" ON "winning_result".driverid = "d".driverid AND "winning_result".position = 1 INNER JOIN "races" AS "first_win" ON "first_win".raceid = "winning_result".raceid WHERE "first_win".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "d".dob ASC NULLS LAST, "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname ASC, "first_win".date ASC, "first_win".name ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name AS "constructor_name" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "q".raceid AND "res".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]{3}$' ORDER BY split_part("q".q2, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60000 + (split_part("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC * 1000) ASC, "res".grid ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND (split_part("q".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "q2".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+[.][0-9]+$' AND split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 <> 'N/A' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '' AND "q2".q3 <> 'N/A') LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "res".time AS "runner_up_gap" FROM (SELECT raceid, year FROM "races" WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time::TIME ASC, year DESC LIMIT 1) AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".position = 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 LIKE '%:%' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time::TIME <= TIME '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC < 98 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1991-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".dob ORDER BY MAX(CAST("r".fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC)) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND ("q".q2 IS NULL OR "q".q2 = '') ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC NULLS FIRST, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid) AS "drivers_withdrew" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".year = 1962 AND "r".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid) FILTER (WHERE "s".status = 'Finished' OR "s".status ~ '^[+][0-9]+ Laps?$') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".year = 1957 AND "r".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("e".cost::NUMERIC) AS "event_total" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST("e".expense_date AS DATE)) IN (9, 10) GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_expenses" LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "difference" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN "b".amount END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN "b".amount END), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' AND "e".event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting') LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING SUM("b".amount) <> 0 AND SUM("b".spent)::NUMERIC / SUM("b".amount) = (SELECT MAX("r".ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM("b2".spent)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM("b2".amount), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b2" ON "b2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e2".event_id) AS "r") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

SELECT "w".headcount AS "womens_soccer_attendance", "a".average_attendance, CASE WHEN "w".headcount > "a".average_attendance THEN 'more' WHEN "w".headcount < "a".average_attendance THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "att".link_to_member) AS "headcount" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "att" ON "att".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS "w" CROSS JOIN (SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_attendance".headcount), 1) AS "average_attendance" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "att".link_to_member) AS "headcount" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "att" ON "att".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE CAST("e".event_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND CAST("e".event_date AS DATE) < DATE '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance") AS "a" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".department, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".major_id) AS "majors_offered", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".member_id IS NOT NULL THEN "d".major_id END) AS "majors_held", ROUND(COUNT("m".member_id)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "d".major_id), 0), 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "major" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "d".major_id WHERE "d".department IN (SELECT "c".department FROM "major" AS "c" WHERE "c".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') GROUP BY "d".department ORDER BY "d".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_type", COALESCE(SUM("a".attendee_count), 0) AS "members_attended", COALESCE(SUM("b".budgeted_amount), 0) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "budgeted_amount" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT department, college FROM "major" WHERE college IN (SELECT college FROM "major" WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department')) AS "d" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "m".department = "d".department AND "m".college = "d".college LEFT JOIN (SELECT "mem".member_id, "mem".link_to_major FROM "member" AS "mem" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member FROM "attendance") AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "mem".member_id WHERE "mem".position = 'Member') AS "enrolled" ON "enrolled".link_to_major = "m".major_id LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "enrolled".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' GROUP BY "d".department ORDER BY "d".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount::NUMERIC - COALESCE("b".spent, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member, link_to_budget FROM "expense" WHERE cost > 50) AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".link_to_member FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game') AS "attendees" ON "attendees".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_name) AS "major_count" FROM "major" AS "m" WHERE "m".college IN (SELECT "tm".college FROM "member" AS "t" INNER JOIN "major" AS "tm" ON "tm".major_id = "t".link_to_major WHERE "t".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "t".last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "enrolled" INNER JOIN "major" AS "em" ON "em".major_id = "enrolled".link_to_major WHERE "em".college = "m".college AND "em".major_name = "m".major_name) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("t".member_count), 2) AS "average_members_attended" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "b".category = 'Advertisement' LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "t" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "m".major_id = "mem".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "m".major_id, "m".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".link_to_member) FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "mem2" ON "mem2".member_id = "a2".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "m2".major_id = "mem2".link_to_major WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "m2".major_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".link_to_member) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY "m".major_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "m" WHERE "m".link_to_major = "maj".major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" AS "maj" LIMIT 501
