SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "m".position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN COALESCE("a".event_count, 0) END), 2) AS "average_events_per_officer", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "m".position NOT IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') OR "m".position IS NULL THEN COALESCE("a".event_count, 0) END), 2) AS "average_events_per_other_student" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_event) AS "event_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_member) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n)))) AS "count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5) AS "n" ON "n".n <= 1 + LENGTH("e".expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE("e".expense_description, ',', '')) WHERE "b".link_to_event IN (SELECT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount - spent < 0) LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_spent, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendee_count, 2) AS "water_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost::NUMERIC) AS "water_spent" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "departments".department IS NOT NULL) AS "members_in_college", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "departments".department IS NULL) AS "members_not_in_college" FROM "member" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "r".link_to_major = "m".major_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' AND department IS NOT NULL) AS "departments" ON "m".department = "departments".department LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "cb".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "cb" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "cb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "x".cost > 0) AS "eligible" ON "eligible".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING MAX("b".amount) = (SELECT MAX("b2".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b2" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "cb2".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "cb2" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x2" ON "x2".link_to_budget = "cb2".budget_id WHERE "x2".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "x2".cost > 0) AS "eligible2" ON "eligible2".link_to_event = "b2".link_to_event) LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_date, SUM("e".cost::NUMERIC) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President' AND "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX("e2".expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "e2".link_to_member = "m2".member_id WHERE "m2".position = 'Vice President') GROUP BY "e".expense_date ORDER BY "e".expense_date DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_category", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".college, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id GROUP BY "ma".college HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "member" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma2" ON "m2".link_to_major = "ma2".major_id GROUP BY "ma2".college ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY "ma".college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "number_of_different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "qualifying_budget" ON "qualifying_budget".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "qualifying_budget".amount > 40 INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "b".link_to_event INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "pb".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "pb" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "pb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description = 'Pizza') AS "pizza" ON "pizza".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date::DATE >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date::DATE < DATE '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_spending".total_spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "total_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_spending" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "total_budget", SUM(spent) AS "total_spent" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM(CASE WHEN "x".expense_description IS NULL OR TRIM("x".expense_description) = '' THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH("x".expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE("x".expense_description, ',', '')) + 1 END) AS "purchases" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "p" ON "p".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' AND COALESCE("b".total_spent, 0) <= COALESCE("b".total_budget, 0) ORDER BY COALESCE("p".purchases, 0) DESC, "e".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "e".type, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date::DATE >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date::DATE < DATE '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type HAVING COUNT("a".link_to_member) = (SELECT MAX("t".member_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT("a2".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".event_date::DATE >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND "e2".event_date::DATE < DATE '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e2".type) AS "t") LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT initcap(TRIM(split_part("x".expense_description, ',', "n".n))) AS "item_name", "b".category, SUM("x".cost::NUMERIC) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) AS "n" WHERE "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "x".approved = 'true' AND TRIM(split_part("x".expense_description, ',', "n".n)) <> '' GROUP BY initcap(TRIM(split_part("x".expense_description, ',', "n".n))), "b".category ORDER BY "b".category ASC, item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE("b".total_budgeted, 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COALESCE("a".member_count, 0) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT item_name, COUNT(*) AS "times_bought" FROM (SELECT TRIM(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', 1)) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name = 'Harrison' UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', 2)) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name = 'Harrison' UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', 3)) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name = 'Harrison') AS "items" WHERE item_name <> '' GROUP BY item_name LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", "s".kind_count, (SELECT SUM("e".cost::NUMERIC) FROM "expense" AS "e" WHERE "e".link_to_member = "s".link_to_member AND "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01') AS "total_spending" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT "e".link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(split_part("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n)))) AS "kind_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) AS "n" ON "n".n <= 1 + length("e".expense_description) - length(replace("e".expense_description, ',', '')) WHERE "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".link_to_member) AS "s" ON "s".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "s".kind_count = (SELECT MAX("t".kind_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(split_part("e2".expense_description, ',', "n2".n)))) AS "kind_count" FROM "expense" AS "e2" INNER JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) AS "n2" ON "n2".n <= 1 + length("e2".expense_description) - length(replace("e2".expense_description, ',', '')) WHERE "e2".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e2".expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e2".link_to_member) AS "t") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ma".major_id) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id WHERE "ma".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour, COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour IS NOT NULL AND "c".colour NOT IN ('No Colour', 'N/A') GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "c".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel_neutral_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') LIMIT 501
SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "c".colour, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "h" ON "h".id = "s".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "sk" ON "sk".id = "s".skin_colour_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "c".colour = "h".colour AND "c".colour = "sk".colour AND "c".colour NOT IN ('No Colour', '-', 'N/A', 'Unknown') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("h".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "h".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "h".height_cm > 0 AND "h".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "dc_hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "dc_hp" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "dc_h" ON "dc_h".id = "dc_hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dc_p" ON "dc_p".id = "dc_h".publisher_id WHERE "dc_p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc_powers" ON "dc_powers".power_id = "hp".power_id WHERE "dc_powers".power_id IS NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hs".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hs" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "s" ON "s".id = "hs".power_id WHERE "s".power_name = 'Super Strength') AS "strength_heroes" ON "strength_heroes".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT("strength_heroes".hero_id) > 0 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT("strength_heroes".hero_id)) AS "powers" LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment IS NULL OR "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

SELECT power_name, hero_count FROM (SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) DESC) AS "power_rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' GROUP BY "sp".id, "sp".power_name) AS "ranked" WHERE power_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "ab_ha".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ab_ha" ON "ab_ha".hero_id = "ab".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "ab_a" ON "ab_a".id = "ab_ha".attribute_id WHERE "ab".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "ab_a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT("h".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" AS "g" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "s".id, "s".gender_id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue' GROUP BY "s".id, "s".gender_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) >= 10) AS "h" ON "h".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::BIGINT AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "hha".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hha" ON "hha".hero_id = "h".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "h_a" ON "h_a".id = "hha".attribute_id WHERE "h".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "h_a".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "superpower_count" FROM (SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC NULLS LAST) AS "height_rank" FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL) AS "ranked_heroes" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "ranked_heroes".id WHERE "ranked_heroes".height_rank <= 10 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "character_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".race_id IS NULL AND "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "r".race = 'God / Eternal' AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "s".id) AS "hero_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("portfolio".power_count), 1) AS "average_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "hp".hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "shared".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "shared" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cryo_hero" ON "cryo_hero".power_id = "shared".power_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cryo_power" ON "cryo_power".hero_id = "cryo_hero".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "cryo_power".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Cryokinesis') AS "eligible" ON "eligible".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".hero_id) AS "portfolio" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg > 0 AND "dc".eye_colour_id IN (SELECT "marvel".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "mp" ON "mp".id = "marvel".publisher_id WHERE "mp".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm), 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".race_id IN (SELECT race_id FROM "superhero" WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') AND "s".height_cm > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".race_id IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "superhero" AS "f" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "f".gender_id WHERE "f".race_id = "s".race_id AND "g".gender = 'Female') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "publisher" AS "p" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 AND "p".publisher_name <> 'N/A' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT("s".weight_kg) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "h" WHERE "h".publisher_id IN (SELECT "b".publisher_id FROM "superhero" AS "b" WHERE "b".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' AND "b".publisher_id IS NOT NULL) AND "h".id IN (SELECT "x".id FROM "superhero" AS "x" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other" ON "other".eye_colour_id = "x".eye_colour_id AND "other".publisher_id <> "x".publisher_id WHERE "other".publisher_id IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AND "r".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r".id, "r".race HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(race_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "race_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "r2".id = "s2".race_id WHERE "s2".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AND "r2".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r2".id) AS "counts") LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value), 1) AS "average_intelligence" FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')) AS "eligible" ON "eligible".hero_id = "ha".hero_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("p".power_count, 0)), 2) AS "average_superpowers" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY hero_id) AS "p" ON "p".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND TRIM("s".full_name) ~ '^[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]''.-]*([[:space:]]+[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]''.-]*)+$' GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm > 0), 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg > 0), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "s".height_cm > 0 THEN "s".height_cm END), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "s".weight_kg > 0 THEN "s".weight_kg END), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm), 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') AS "shared" ON "shared".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "s".height_cm > 0 AND "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "p".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".power_name = 'Flight') AS "flyers" ON "flyers".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "superpower_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg < 70 AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm > 0 ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(power_count) AS "largest_number_of_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "p".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "s".weight_kg = (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg > 0) GROUP BY "s".id) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) NOT IN ('-', 'N/A') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "hair".colour <> 'Brown') AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "hero" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "eye".id = "hero".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "hair".id = "hero".hair_colour_id GROUP BY "eye".id, "eye".colour HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "hair".colour = 'Brown') > 0 ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "eye".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND btrim("s".full_name) ~ '^[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]''.-]*[[:space:]]+[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]''.-]*(?:[[:space:]]+[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]''.-]*)*$' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "h" WHERE "h".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "h".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "h".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0 THEN "p".id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5 THEN "p".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE ("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE glu >= 180 AND "T-CHO" < 250) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_female" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE pt >= 14) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday <= DATE '2026-10-09' - INTERVAL '56 years' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".description IS NULL AND "l".crp LIKE '%+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory") AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "l"."T-BIL", "l".date, "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX(rnp::NUMERIC) FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') AND "l"."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX(rnp::NUMERIC) FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 10 ELSE FALSE END) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "l".rnp AS "anti-RNP titer" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "l".rnp = (SELECT "r".rnp FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p2".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s2" ON "s2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-' AND "s2".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "r".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') ORDER BY CAST("r".rnp AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' GROUP BY "p".id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 THEN 1 END) > 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') THEN 1 END) > 0) AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".test_dates, 0)), 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "test_dates" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("l2".dna AS NUMERIC)) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".sex = 'F' AND "p2".admission = '+' AND "l2".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') ORDER BY "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') GROUP BY "p".admission LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) AND CASE WHEN "r".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST("r".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 16 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST(rnp AS NUMERIC)) AS "highest_anti_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "at least one normal platelet result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "never had a normal platelet result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt > 100 AND plt < 400) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '^[[:space:]]*(RA[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*SJS|SJS[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*RA)[[:space:]]*$' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp::NUMERIC - 8.5), 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "examination" WHERE diagnosis ~ '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND diagnosis !~ 'SLE[[:space:]]+susp') AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('256') THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256', 'negative') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') AS "women", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "men" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "youngest_age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) >= 64 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE 'psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e"."symptoms" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "e"."id" WHERE "p"."diagnosis" ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e"."thrombosis" = 1 AND "e"."symptoms" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e"."symptoms" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e"."symptoms" ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(first_examination - "First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p"."First Date", MIN("e"."Examination Date") AS "first_examination" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' GROUP BY "p".id, "p"."First Date") AS "patient_examinations" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '+2(100)', '>=1000', '>=300') AND "l"."U-PRO" <> '+2(100)' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "women_minus_men" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patients_with_high_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cre >= 1.5 WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".admission, "p".id, "l"."T-CHO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = "p".admission) ORDER BY "p".admission ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id, CAST("l".rnp AS BIGINT) AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l".rnp AS BIGINT) = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "l2".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l2".rnp AS BIGINT) END) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p2"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01') ORDER BY "l".id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT AVG(hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') AND hct IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p"."id") FILTER (WHERE "p"."admission" IN ('+', '+(')) AS "admitted", COUNT(DISTINCT "p"."id") FILTER (WHERE "p"."admission" = '-') AS "outpatient" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."diagnosis" = 'SLE' AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=1000', '>=300') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+') WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_sample_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "sample" ON "sample".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_result_date" FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AS "result" ON "result".id = "l".id AND "result".latest_result_date = "l".date WHERE "sample".latest_sample_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".id WHERE "s".ssa IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM("s".ssa)) NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "u"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM("u"."U-PRO")) NOT IN ('negative', 'none', '-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "female_patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND CASE WHEN TRIM("l".dna) ~ '^[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)$' THEN CAST(TRIM("l".dna) AS NUMERIC) < 8 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp <> 'negative' THEN CAST(rnp AS INTEGER) END) AS "highest_anti_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE cre < 1.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT id, date, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(rnp AS NUMERIC) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(rnp AS NUMERIC)) FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "eligible_patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT("l".ldh) AS "normal_ldh_measurements" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".ldh < 500 WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".id, "t".sex, "t".highest_rnp FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) END) AS "highest_rnp", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) END) DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rnk" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex HAVING MIN("l".hgb) < 10) AS "t" WHERE "t".rnk = 1 AND "t".highest_rnp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MIN("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id) AND "l".got < 60 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 10 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id AND "l2"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 4 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 0 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC >= 16 ELSE FALSE END) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday ORDER BY MAX("l".gpt) DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) >= 16 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l"."date", "p"."birthday")) AS "age", "p"."diagnosis" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "l"."id" WHERE "p"."admission" = '+' AND "l"."dna" ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' ORDER BY CAST("l"."dna" AS NUMERIC) DESC, "l"."date" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE[[:space:]]+susp' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".id IS NOT NULL) AS "at_least_one_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".id IS NULL) AS "no_such_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256')) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, igg FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL AND date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "latest".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna AS "highest anti-DNA test result" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna::NUMERIC) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l2".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') GROUP BY "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (SELECT "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST, "l".igg DESC LIMIT 1) > 900 AND (SELECT "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST, "l".igg DESC LIMIT 1) < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "female_minus_male" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 32 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) > 64 ELSE FALSE END AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id AND "l2".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l2".date IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '-') AS "outpatients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday HAVING MAX("l".ldh) >= 500 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN "l"."U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "number of female patients" FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e"."symptoms", "p"."diagnosis" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "e"."diagnosis" ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "e"."diagnosis" !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "e"."symptoms" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."symptoms" <> '' AND "p"."birthday" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p"."birthday" DESC, "p"."id" ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND admission IN ('+', '+(') AND birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ("First Date" - birthday) DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average anti-cardiolipin IgM concentration" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE "diagnosis" ILIKE 'psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "male_patients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') AS "female_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rbc < 3.5) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "number_of_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average anti-cardiolipin IgM concentration" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SJS([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SJS[[:space:]]+susp' AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ~* '(^|,)[[:space:]]*SjS[[:space:]]*(,|$)' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id AND "s".sm IN ('negative', '0') INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".id AND "u"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id GROUP BY "p".id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "e".thrombosis = 0) > 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "e".thrombosis <> 0) = 0) AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "a" ON "a".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("r".rbc <= 3.5 OR "r".rbc >= 6.0) AND "a".rnp IN ('1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday <= DATE '2026-10-09' AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 15 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".date < "p".birthday + INTERVAL '50 years' AND "l".date >= "p".birthday AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("l"."U-PRO") NOT IN ('', '-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'o' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_occurrences" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "a".element IN ('i', 's') AND "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id, "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '#') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "atom" WHERE element IN ('p', 'br')) AS "p" ON "p".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "hydrogen_fraction", "m".label FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "s".molecule_id IS NULL THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END AS "molecule_group", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type <> '-') AS "s" ON "s".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN "s".molecule_id IS NULL THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END ORDER BY molecule_group DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "carbon_carbon_double_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' LIMIT 501

SELECT "ranked".element, ROUND(100.0 * "ranked".bonded_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "all_atoms" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "all_molecules" ON "all_molecules".molecule_id = "all_atoms".molecule_id WHERE "all_molecules".label = '+'), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "bonded_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) DESC) AS "element_rank" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "a".element) AS "ranked" WHERE "ranked".element_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "types".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 'single' WHEN '=' THEN 'double' WHEN '#' THEN 'triple' END AS "bond_type", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' THEN "b".bond_id END) AS "count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT bond_type FROM "bond") AS "types" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_type = "types".bond_type LEFT JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "types".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "types".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "atom_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "s" ON "s".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "s".element = 's' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT MIN(molecule_id) AS "molecule_id" FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) AS "unique_elements" ON "unique_elements".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element = 'n' GROUP BY "a".molecule_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 END) = 0) AS "qualifying_molecules" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "chlorine" ON "c".atom_id = "chlorine".atom_id WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "carcinogenic_percent", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '-') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "non_carcinogenic_percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '#') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT element FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) AS "rare" ON "rare".element = "a".element LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("b".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC, "a".atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", "m".molecule_id, "m".label, "a".atom_count, COALESCE("b".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "a".carbon_count, "a".chlorine_count, COALESCE("b".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COALESCE("b".multiple_bonds, 0) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "carbon_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id) AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "bo".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "cb".bond_id IS NOT NULL) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "bo".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "bond" AS "bo" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".bond_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "ca" ON "ca".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "ca".element = 'c') AS "cb" ON "cb".bond_id = "bo".bond_id GROUP BY "bo".molecule_id) AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".carbon_count > 0 ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "y" ON "y".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "h".element = 'h' AND "y".element = 'y' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("atom_bonds".bond_count), 2) AS "average_bonds_per_atom" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "carbon" ON "carbon".atom_id = "c".atom_id AND "carbon".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 AND "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "carbon".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a".element LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY bond_count DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT("s".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "a2".atom_id FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a2".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "a2".atom_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') > 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) = 0) AS "s" ON "s".atom_id = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".element IN (SELECT "a2".element FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
